Kingfisher — Kenya fishing methods ↗
SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Choose one primary fishing objective and request a departure plan from the operator. The range of advertised methods does not mean all are offered on every day; confirm which boat and gear support your choice.

Build around a confirmed boat plan

Ask the crew to identify the primary target and method, the actual time spent fishing and how anglers share the available positions. Confirm the tackle that is supplied before buying rods or terminal gear. Keep spare clothing and electronics protected from spray.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Kenya

Recreational anglers must apply to the county where they will fish. The 2024 rules require a personal fishing licence; do not assume a boat or club licence covers the client.

  • Recreational fishing licenceRecreational fishing licence
Official rules ↗

Rules for this water

  • Do not fish within Malindi Marine National Park.
  • Confirm the charter route stays outside closed park zones; the adjacent reserve has separate management rules.

Full Kenya licence guide ↗ · Checked November 2026.
